slides.header: Repair or replace? Here's how we actually decide.

slides.body: A roof under 15 with an isolated problem gets repaired. A roof past 20 with widespread issues gets replaced. The honest work happens in the middle.

slides.header: Is the problem local or general?
slides.body: One flashing failure is local. Granule loss across every slope is general. Repairs fix local problems; they can't fix general ones.
A $1,500 repair with ten good years left costs $150 a year. With two years left, it costs $750 a year, and you still buy the replacement.
Repair frequency is the roof telling you its own diagnosis. Once fixes become a subscription, the math has already flipped.
A thorough assessment with photos turns 'oldish and leaks sometimes' into specifics, slope by slope. Decisions get easy when the facts get specific. Ours is free.
Summer is decision season. Make the call before the rain makes it for you. Schedule a FREE Roof Assessment with French Roofing.
